meta.parties: Saravanamuttu v. Sinappa Aiyar Et Al

rules.statement: The plaintiff is entitled to a declaration that he is the manager of the temple and an injunction to restrain the defendant from interfering with his management, provided there is no evidence showing he has been removed or voluntarily withdrawn from his office.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion he is entitled to a declaration that he is the manager, and to an injunction to restrain the defendant from interfering with his management, and to an order for delivery to him of the articles specified in the plaint."
